request.description: Change ONLY the POSE of this exact character into a complete FULL-BODY seated RIDER, facing RIGHT in a three-quarter side view. She sits ASTRIDE an invisible wide saddle, torso leaning slightly forward, hips seated, BOTH THIGHS present and bent forward, knees bent about 90 degrees, lower legs hanging downward with BOTH FEET and shoes visible. Near leg wraps down the near side; far leg is partly visible on the far side. Arms reach forward naturally to hold imaginary reins. Keep EXACT face, hair, outfit, accessories, chibi proportions, colors and pixel style. Show the ENTIRE character from head to shoes. Never cut the body at the waist. No standing legs. No animal, saddle, chair, reins, background, floor or effects: only the full seated person on transparency. This is a rider sprite that will be layered on an animated animal.
